rules.sentence: It is crucial to note that any appendiceal tumor can present as acute appendicitis, making the preoperative diagnosis uncertain.

The indications for appendectomy remain similar to non-neoplastic conditions and should be decided according to the physical examination, laboratory, and imaging findings present at the initial presentation.[9]
It is crucial to note that any appendiceal tumor can present as acute appendicitis, making the preoperative diagnosis uncertain.
